geographicScope.description: Published Reichsgebiet census population for June 1925. The source does not establish equivalence to the atlas entity-germany boundary geometry; territorial comparability requires historical review. The 31 December 1937 territorial footnote belongs only to the 1939 row.

evidence.note: Actual PDF body read: Statistisches Jahrbuch 2019, printed page 26, table 2.1.2. Population unit is 1,000; 1925 row gives 62,411 and footnote 1 marks census results. Table chronology identifies June 1925; territorial heading identifies Reichsgebiet for 1871–1939. Footnote 2 (31 December 1937 territory) is attached to 1939 only. Conversion multiplies the rounded published thousand-person value by 1,000; no interpolation.

cautions: Published value is rounded to thousands; conversion to persons does not add precision.
Census statistical territory is retained as published; comparability with atlas geometry is unverified.
Observation is June 1925 only, not annual or surrounding-year population coverage.

absenceOfEvidence: The reviewed table supplies month precision, not an exact census day.
No documentary comparison of the census statistical territory and atlas polygon was established.
